title: Derived open direct image on a K-injective complex
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme, $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and $A$ a finite ring, not necessarily commutative. Use the small pro-etale sites and coefficient sheaves $A_S$ and left module categories of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], in compatible small skeletons and a common sheaf universe. The module inverse image $j^*$ with transported action [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact] is identified with restriction to $T_{\mathrm{proet}}/U=U_{\mathrm{proet}}$, including its coefficient action and adjunction unit. In particular $(j^*N)(W\to U)=N(W\to T)$, and the unit on an object $V\to T$ is restriction $N(V)\to N(V\times_TU)$, using the direct-image formula of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image].

For every K-injective cochain complex $I$ of left $A_T$-module sheaves, the restricted complex $j^*I$ is K-injective. Here K-injective means that every chain map from an acyclic complex is homotopic to zero [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]. Let $Q_S$ denote derived localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $Rj_*$ be the total right derived functor of $j_*$ [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived]. Then $Rj_*j^*(Q_TI)$ is represented by $Q_T(j_*j^*I)$. Under this representation and $Q_Uj^*I=j^*Q_TI$, the unit of the derived adjunction $j^*\dashv Rj_*$ at $Q_TI$ is $Q_T(I\to j_*j^*I)$, with the termwise restriction maps just specified.
